sn48.5:1.1: pajānāti || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || || Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ || pe || paññindriyaṃ || || Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako imesam pañcannam indriyānam assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti || ayam vuccati bhikkhave arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohītabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññā vimutto ti || || Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni
